title: Loading
note: Progress follows real readiness. Racket illustration stands in for a short in-engine idle; no generated character replacement.

title: Drone flyover
note: Lower-left venue ticket during the existing flyover. Current court capture is a composition backdrop, not a new camera specification.

title: Match intro
note: Use equipped avatar portraits in the two open cards in production. Rules text is supplied by the actual match format.

title: Timing / pre-game check
note: Explicit captured-swing count and retry state. Example total is illustrative; bind the real calibration count, never hard-code six.

title: Return-serve / coaching
note: One prompt at a time, placed below play. Hide after the serve begins; a first-time coaching hint may replace this line.

title: Serve timing
note: Timing remains skillful. This panel replaces the current colored serve bar at integration; that existing world-space bar remains visible in the unmodified backdrop.

title: Scorebug / active play
note: Most of the court stays clear. Scorebug shows names, games, points, and a serving dot. Rally badge is brief after a milestone, not constantly animated.

title: Shot quality system
note: Grades use both labels and color. Speeds are illustrative; render actual shot speed. No ultimate or SUPER power badge.

title: Umpire / match calls
note: Replace current mixed word-art with one ticket family. Queue one call; point results take precedence over shot badges. No camera cut.

title: Point / score change
note: Keep the third-person camera. Short score-change card at the upper edge; it clears before the next serve.

title: Set complete
note: Phone must expose the same Continue action only after set completion. Also offer Exit on the phone; never ask for a swing here.

title: Pause / exit confirmation
note: Pause stops input and match time. Destructive confirmation reuses this modal; primary becomes Keep playing, secondary Exit match.

title: Connection recovery
note: Differentiate controller disconnected, display disconnected, and loading failure. Display loss returns controls to the phone; no fake online reconnect.

title: Match complete / campaign win
note: Persistent actions, never auto-dismiss. Next round appears only when eligible; casual win uses Replay as primary. Live equipped hero replaces the racket vignette in production.

title: Match complete / loss
note: No fake Next unlock after a loss. Same layout and dignity as victory; friendly language without mocking the player.

title: Optional rewards / identity
note: Use only real reward data. This optional screen never blocks Replay, Continue, or Exit; unlock art is a separate cosmetic thumbnail slot.

title: Phone / active controller
note: The controller’s playing state. Dive readiness/cooldown changes the same button; it never becomes an ultimate.

title: Phone / post-game actions
note: Campaign example. Hide Next when ineligible. Button taps acknowledge/loading/disable repeat taps; failure restores actions with an inline message.

title: Loading delay / retry
note: 8 seconds: still loading status. At existing 20-second stalled threshold: retry/menu. Never fake a completed progress bar or strand the controller.

title: Shared components / other sports
note: Golf uses the same components with sport-specific metrics. No gameplay changes or unsupported features implied by this design study.

title: Shot feedback / in context
note: The same feedback component in context: one brief badge, clear of the near player. No camera change.

title: Display / screen check
note: Manual confirmation fallback avoids making camera recognition of a MacBook a hard gate. Real device connection state still determines the next step.

title: Tutorial / first swing
note: Instruction and actual completion state are separate. Advance when the action succeeds; no unreachable movement goals. Steps/count come from the playable tutorial.

title: In-match sound / controls
note: Example control styling; bind only supported settings. Native sliders/toggles receive labels, values, focus and larger-text layouts.

title: Exit confirmation
note: Only when abandoning an active match. Completed-match Exit returns immediately; it must not trap the player behind another confirmation.
